options_evaluated: Virgin ABS plastic with co-molded TPE grips
Post-consumer recycled (PCR) polypropylene (PP) with monomaterial structure
Bio-based PLA composite with glass fiber reinforcement
assessments.recommendation: Post-consumer recycled (PCR) polypropylene (PP) with monomaterial structure
assessments.rationale: Using PCR PP directly addresses parameter (h) by maximizing recycled content, while a monomaterial structure avoids incompatible polymer contamination (such as co-molded TPE on ABS), optimizing the design for recycling (d). This reduces both the material footprint (o) and environmental footprint (m) prior to manufacturing.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing and assembly (PCR resins can exhibit higher shrinkage variability and cosmetic defects during injection molding) and Product use and maintenance (PP has lower impact strength and scratch resistance than virgin ABS, potentially reducing physical durability).
espr_parameters: (h) use or content of recycled materials

It enables non-destructive disassembly, directly supporting design for recycling (d) and the potential incorporation of used components (k) during future remanufacturing.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing and assembly (increases assembly cycle time and part count compared to automated ultrasonic welding) and Product use and maintenance (screws may loosen over time due to motor vibration, requiring user retightening).

options_evaluated: Standard brushed DC motor with heavy copper windings
High-efficiency brushless DC (BLDC) motor with neodymium magnets
Synchronous reluctance motor without permanent rare-earth magnets
assessments.recommendation: Synchronous reluctance motor without permanent rare-earth magnets
assessments.rationale: Eliminating permanent rare-earth magnets avoids critical raw materials which carry high environmental footprints (m) and are classified as substances of concern (f) due to toxic extraction processes. This significantly reduces the product's pre-manufacture material footprint (o) and simplifies end-of-life magnetic separation during recycling (d).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Product use and maintenance (synchronous reluctance motors generally have lower power density, which may increase the overall weight of the hand unit and reduce energy efficiency during high-suction operation).

options_evaluated: Active cooling with dedicated auxiliary fan and aluminum heatsinks
Passive cooling via optimized ventilation grilles and conductive PCR plastic housing
Phase change materials (PCM) encapsulated in polyurethane foam
assessments.recommendation: Passive cooling via optimized ventilation grilles and conductive PCR plastic housing
assessments.rationale: Passive cooling eliminates the need for additional copper-wired fans and heavy aluminum heatsinks, directly supporting lightweight design (t) and reducing the weight and volume of the product (j). Utilizing conductive PCR plastic also fulfills the goal of incorporating recycled materials (h).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Product use and maintenance (passive cooling relies heavily on unobstructed airflow, which can lead to thermal throttling or motor overheating if the user neglects filter maintenance).
espr_parameters: (h) use or content of recycled materials
(j) weight and volume of the product and its packaging

options_evaluated: Modular cartridge design with easily separable functional blocks (motor, battery, filtration)
Semi-modular layout with soldered wire harnesses
assessments.recommendation: Modular cartridge design with easily separable functional blocks (motor, battery, filtration)
assessments.rationale: A modular architecture allows individual high-wear components to be easily separated, facilitating the incorporation of used or remanufactured components (k) and simplifying end-of-life sorting for design for recycling (d). This prevents the premature disposal of the entire product, minimizing the long-term material footprint (o).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing and assembly (requires more complex internal connectors, structural housing partitions, and higher initial manufacturing tolerances, increasing assembly cost).

options_evaluated: Corded AC power supply with integrated cable reel
Removable and standardized Li-ion battery pack
Internal pouch-cell Li-ion battery pack glued to the chassis
assessments.recommendation: Corded AC power supply with integrated cable reel
assessments.rationale: A corded design completely eliminates the need for lithium-ion battery chemistry, avoiding massive amounts of substances of concern (f) like cobalt and nickel, and dramatically reducing the product's pre-manufacture environmental footprint (m) and material footprint (o). It also eliminates battery degradation as a premature product end-of-life driver.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Product use and maintenance (severely restricts user mobility, increases physical weight due to the copper cable and mechanical reel, and reduces convenience compared to cordless alternatives).
